description_en: Queries the daily bills for WAF pay-as-you-go instances for the last 7 days
description_zh: 查询WAF按量实例近7天的每日账单
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-elastic-bills --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeElasticBills

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
